positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "Reasonable laws that protect Second Amendment rights while ensuring that felons, fugitives, domestic abusers and other dangerous individuals do not have access to guns help prevent violence and save lives," said Smith. "This common-sense legislation would ensure that firearms are purchased, owned and used by responsible, law-abiding citizens by closing the "private sale loophole' and listing all those prohibited from buying a firearm in the National Instant Criminal Background Check System."
